jd.title: AI transformation lead
jd.raw_text:
Job Description
Job Title: AI Program Enablement Lead
Company: Paves Technologies
Location: Dubai, UAE (on-site)
Engagement Type: Contract (via Paves Technologies)
Industry: Payments / Fintech / Financial Services
About Paves Technologies
Paves Technologies is a cards, payments and banking technology consulting firm. We help banks, payment providers and fintechs deliver complex technology, transformation and delivery programs across the payments value chain, including in regulated and PCI DSS-aware environments. Through our contracting practice, we place senior specialists into high-impact roles with leading clients across the region.
Role Overview
On behalf of our client a leading payments and financial technology organization operating across the Middle East; we are seeking an experienced AI Program Enablement Lead to drive an enterprise-wide AI transformation journey. This role shapes how AI is governed, adopted, scaled and embedded across the organization, working directly with executive leadership to define and deliver AI strategy and responsible AI adoption at enterprise scale.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and drive the client's enterprise AI transformation agenda.
Establish and operationalize AI governance frameworks, operating models, policies and controls.
Partner with senior leaders across Business, Technology, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Data, Finance and HR to accelerate AI adoption.
Design and lead an AI Champions Program to build a strong enterprise AI community.
Drive AI communications, change management, training and workforce capability-building initiatives.
Manage enterprise AI platforms, including vendor relationships, licensing, budgets, adoption metrics and performance monitoring.
Support executive governance forums and leadership decision-making through clear reporting and actionable insights.
Build strategic partnerships and innovation initiatives that strengthen AI capabilities and business outcomes.
Required Experience & Skills
Significant experience in AI transformation, digital transformation, strategy, innovation, technology governance or enterprise change.
Strong understanding of Generative AI, Responsible AI, AI governance, AI operating models and enterprise adoption.
Demonstrated experience leading complex transformation programs across multiple business functions.
Proven ability to engage and influence senior executives and key stakeholders.
Experience with governance frameworks, policies, risk management, controls and executive reporting.
Strong program management, change management and communication capabilities.
Desirable
Experience within financial services, fintech, payments or other highly regulated industries.
Exposure to regional (Middle East / Africa) markets and multi-country operating environments.
What We Offer
The opportunity to shape enterprise AI strategy and governance at a leading payments and fintech organization.
Direct engagement with executive leadership on high-visibility transformation initiatives.
A competitive contract rate commensurate with experience.
How to Apply
Submit your CV and a brief summary of relevant experience to careers@example.invalid
